_comment: Ground textures for the terrain shader. Edit prompts here, then run textures.py. Optional per-texture "saturation" scales colour intensity (1 = unchanged).
style: uniform surface texture filling the entire frame edge to edge, viewed from directly above, even soft lighting, no border, no frame, no vignette, no tiles, no grid, no horizon, hand-painted stylized look with soft painterly detail, natural muted colours

textures.prompt: lush meadow grass, dense short green grass blades of varied length
forest floor, soft green moss with fallen brown leaves, pine needles and small twigs
packed brown earth path with small scattered pebbles
weathered grey rock surface with fine cracks and small patches of moss
warm orange desert sand with soft wind ripples
dusty Australian outback ground, muted rusty red-brown earth with darker patches, small scattered pebbles and specks of dry grass
short alpine grass with small grey rocks and tiny white wildflowers
fresh white snow with soft gentle drifts and faint blue shading
pale golden beach sand with tiny shell fragments
light beige gravel footpath of small rounded stones
